title: Towards Empathetic Open-domain Conversation Models: a New Benchmark and Dataset
reasoning: The paper's core objective is to develop and benchmark dialogue models that can generate 'empathetic responses'. Empathy, defined as understanding and acknowledging others' feelings and displaying a caring attitude, is a key communicative skill evaluated. Cultivating empathy and a caring attitude in AI directly relates to the moral and ethical dimensions of human-AI interaction.
